title: Download leads
content_data:
Use this endpoint to download leads. You need to create a download task through [/page/lead/task/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739052936772610) and ensure the task is complete first (`status` = `SUCCEED`). - If the call is successful, the data (UTC+0 Time) is in CSV (original CSV file < = 10MB) or zip (original CSV file > 10MB) format instead of JSON format. - If the endpoint produces an error, it may return a response in JSON format or output an error message in the returned CSV file. This depends on the error type. > **Note**
To protect customer information, only ad account admins can create and query lead download tasks or download the leads. Ad account roles are configured in the Business Center.

If leads are migrated to a Business Center, only Admins of the Business Center can download the leads. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pages/leads/task/download/|/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`:number
`library_id `:number|`advertiser_id`: string
`library_id `:string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** - **For leads data in EEA/CH/UK**: `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/` and the header `x-lead-region: eu`
**Example** ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&task_id={{task_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: ACCESS_TOKEN' \ --header 'x-lead-region: eu' (/code) ``` > **Note**
The new URL with the `eu` header above is effective from July 13th (UTC+0), 2023. After July 13th (UTC+0), if you continue using the old URL `https://ads.us.tiktok.com/open_api/`, you will only receive US leads. If you use the URL `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/` without specifying the region in the header, you will only receive leads from other countries/regions. - **For leads data in US:** - `https://ads.us.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/` (planned to be deprecated in future versions) - **[Or]** `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/` with the header `x-lead-region: us`. - **For leads data in other countries/regions**: `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/` **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {+Conditional}|string| If leads are under an ad account, you must specify the advertiser ID.| |library_id {+Conditional}|string|If leads are under a Business Center, you must specify the ID of the form library that contains the leads.| |task_id {Required}|string| Task ID | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ --data-urlencode "task_id=TASK_ID" \ https://ads.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/task/download/ (/code) ``` ## Response If the endpoint produces an error, it may return a response in JSON format or output an error message in the returned CSV file. This depends on the error type. ### Example Success ```xcodeblock (code Success CSV) lead id,created_time,ad_id,ad_name,adgroup_id,adgroup_name,campaign_id,campaign_name,form_id,form_name,Name,First name,Surname,Gender,Birthday,Phone number,Email,Country,Province/State,City,Address,Please select the service you are interested in?) 6864523782069944581,2020-06-24 12:18:11(UTC+00:00),1674635134905355,,0,,0,,6856667798307864597,test,test,joe,smith,male,1998.02.22,17681120000,test@foo.bar,china,shanghai,shanghai,somewhere,my name is test 6864523781998641414,2020-06-24 12:18:11(UTC+00:00),1674635134905355,,0,,0,,6856667798307864597,test,test,joe,smith,male,1998.02.22,17681120000,test@foo.bar,china,shanghai,shanghai,somewhere,my name is test (/code) ``` Failure ```xcodeblock (code Fail JSON) { "message": "failed to download.", "code": 40000, "data": {} } (/code) ```
